# The prompt surface: files whose changes alter what an agent reads, its instructions, its tools’ descriptions, or
# what decides either. A pull request that touches one waits for the maintainer’s approval in the
# prompt-security-review environment (.github/workflows/prompt-surface-gate.yml; SECURITY.md, “Prompt changes”).
# prompt-surface-scan.yml warns when the rendered prompts change but no line here matched, so this list can’t fall
# behind quietly. tests/prompt-gate.test.mjs fails when a module the rendered text comes from is neither listed here
# nor excused there with a reason. Globs: `*` within a folder, `**/` any folders.
